notes:
Account snapshot: Pelorus is an institutional research & analytics shop serving multi-asset portfolio teams across EU and UK offices. Primary problem: search quality and latency for internal research portal — analysts cannot rely on current vector retrieval for high-precision financial answers.

Key technical requirements (from SE call 2025-02-10):
- Indexing scale: target ~8–12M documents (research notes, filings, transcripts, ML-extracted facts).
- Embedding strategy: 1536-d embeddings (hybrid) with incremental rebuilds; support for batched upserts and timestamp-based reindexing.
- Reranking: two-stage retrieval (ANN candidates -> cross-encoder reranker) to surface high-precision results for long-tail queries.
- Latency target: P95 end-to-end < 120ms for common queries (EU region); acceptable tail up to 250ms for complex rerank flows.
- Cost sensitivity: target fully-loaded cost per query (embeddings + ANN + reranker) < €0.01 average for production volume.
- Throughput: baseline 200 qps sustained during market hours, burst to 1k qps for earnings windows.

Security / deployment constraints:
- Must run in customer VPC in eu-west-1 with customer-managed KMS keys (HSM/KMS) and audit logs forwarded to their SIEM.
- Data residency: custodian requirement that raw documents and embeddings never leave EU jurisdiction.
- Compliance checklist: SOC 2 and ISO27001 required; legal asked for retention controls and deletion APIs.
